evidence.note: Recorded live at the Universal Amphitheatre, Los Angeles, 9 September 1978; Steve "Getdwa" Jordan, drums.

drum_performances.name: Steve Jordan
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Jordan at 21 with Steve Cropper and Duck Dunn, playing the Stax and Chicago blues he grew up on: a number-one album and the Soul Man single.

drums.description: Sam and Dave's Stax hit, live: eighths on the hat, the kick on 1, the "a" of 2, 3 and its "and"; the kick on every eighth in the chorus; a breakdown on the ride and kick. At 117.

transcriptions.note: Human tab, its drum track named for Jordan; some twelve bars shorter than the record
